::: {#exm-null-deviance}

#### The null deviance of the six-patient trial

Three of the six patients recovered, so $\bar\outvar = 1/2$ and @eq-null-deviance gives $D_0 = 2 \times 6 \ln 2$.

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
# null deviance from the formula with ybar = 1/2
wf_null_hand <- 2 * 6 * log(2)
# the null deviance that glm reports
wf_null_glm <- wf_fit$null.deviance
c(by_hand = wf_null_hand, glm = wf_null_glm)
```

Both give $D_0 = `r round(wf_null_glm, 3)`$.

:::
